info.name: Visitor Management System (VMS) - Complete API Collection
info.description: Production-ready Postman collection for all VMS modules: Authentication, RBAC, Visitors, Reception, Documents, Workflows, Calendar, and System Settings.

request.description: Authenticate user credentials and receive JWT access token
Register a new employee or receptionist user

Unlock a locked account after multiple failed attempts
